sloka: गरुडस्तु समाश्वस्तः सन्निवृत्य यथा पुरा ।राक्षसान्द्रावयामास पक्षवातेन कोपितः ।। ७.७.४७ ॥
transliteration: garuḍastu samāśvastaḥ sannivṛtya yathā purā ।rākṣasāndrāvayāmāsa pakṣavātena kopitaḥ ।। 7.7.47 ॥

translations.english: Garuda, having recovered and returned as before, angrily chased away the Rakshasas with the powerful wind generated by his wings.
